digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler snapshot persistence and differ mutation logic
propositions: prev_snapshot.json currently stores full ACLI payload (228.1 MB total, 4.5 MB/day growth) and must be narrowed to store only {jira_key: {}} key-set to reduce storage by >99%

Corpus testing on 400 real revisions demonstrates 218 consecutive pairs have identical key-set, producing byte-identical snapshots with zero commit output; mean symmetric difference is 1.78 keys when set changes

Full prev_snapshot causes 973-998 spurious (outbound, create) mutations whenever fetch window shrinks or project is re-targeted, because keys in prev-but-not-curr emit raw field blobs that reach create_issue; key-set prev emits none

Key-set prev format must preserve dict shape {jira_key: {}} rather than set because check_dual_identity_complete and differ local-only/emit-both branches use local_state[key] or {} guards requiring mapping entries
Corpus mutation-diff on ≥4 real snapshot pairs in both forward and reverse directions must show zero difference in any mutation reaching Jira with non-empty effect to prove the change is safe
